visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a person's hands using a large spoon to mix shredded chicken, rice, and chopped green onions inside a black Kirkland-branded plastic bag. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Scene shifts to a kitchen counter. A man in a white t-shirt feeds two young children (a boy and a girl) from a spoon. The background shows kitchen cabinets and a microwave. (3) Sequence shows a whole roasted chicken being removed from the bag, leaving behind dark juices. Green onions are sprinkled into the bag, followed by a large scoop of white rice. (4) The man and the young boy watch as the rice is stirred into the juices inside the bag. The man wears a white t-shirt. (5) Shredded chicken is added back into the rice mixture. The spoon lifts a portion of the finished 'chicken oil rice' toward the camera. (6) Back to the counter, the man feeds the children again. They both react with excitement. The man then takes a large bite, reacting with wide eyes and enthusiastic nodding. (7) A close-up shows a bowl filled with the rice mixture. Chopsticks pick up a piece of chicken. The man continues talking to the camera in the kitchen setting.

The narrator's speech becomes more instructional over steady BGM. (5) A 'pop' SFX as ingredients are mentioned. (6) Noticeable 'sloshing' and 'rustling' sounds as rice is mixed inside a plastic bag. (7) Another 'ding' SFX as more rice is added. (8) 'Pop' SFX punctuates the addition of shredded meat. (9) Excited murmurs and high-valence vocalizations from children eating. (10) Narrator takes a bite, followed by a loud 'Oh!' exclamation with high arousal and spectral brightness. (11) Exaggerated crunching and chewing sounds. (12) The narrator concludes with rapid enthusiastic speech, with the BGM maintaining a constant cheerful beat until the end.
